<div class="ref-table">

| Property | What it is |
|---|---|
| `fileActions.save` | The Save callback and its label, for a save the save attribute cannot express; it wins over it. |
| `plugins` | Plugins for this builder alone, beside those the page registered with plugins.register: their components join the catalogue and, through the palette entry each declares, the palette; their data sources reach the canvas and the picker; their validators, hooks, handlers, renditions and sandbox modules reach the previews. A property only. Assigning reseeds the builder. |
| `componentTypes` | Palette entries for component types of your own, appended to the standard palette: a list of { type, label, icon?, group? }. A later entry with the same type replaces an earlier one's label and group. A type needs a definition too (componentDefinitions or a plugin) to draw; without an entry here or a plugin's own palette entry it draws but is not on the palette. The component-types attribute (componentTypeFilter) then narrows the whole palette. |
| `componentDefinitions` | Component types beyond the standard catalogue (a type with a standard one's name replaces it). A type is offered on the palette only when an entry exists for it, from componentTypes or a plugin's palette entry. |
| `icons` | The icon set the builder's chrome draws with. Unset, the set the page registered with setDefaultIconSet, else Datum's own drawings. Setting it repaints in place. |
| `themes`<br>`pluginRegistry` | The registries the builder resolves through: themes for the theme and pdf-theme ids, pluginRegistry for the page's plugins. Each is the page's shared one unless a host hands the element its own. A theme or plugin registered after the element connected is taken up without reseeding the form. |
| `binding`<br>`assets` | The design-system binding the canvas draws the form with, and its files; the canvas's picker offers each binding registered with bindings.register. |
| `formulaFunctions`<br>`formulaReferenceHref` | Extra FEEL functions and the link their help opens. |
| `textLocale`<br>`textCatalog` | The builder's own UI language and its catalog. |
| `pdfConfiguration`<br>`journeyConfiguration` | Object forms of pdf and journeys. |
| `serverChecks` | The object behind wasm. |

</div>
